subject: Question about shuttle voucher service
text: Sorry to reach out in a rush, but the venue's sign-up page is acting up again. I was going to send guests the link for the shuttle voucher service, and the form only loads halfway before the submit button turns gray. I tried a different browser, and it froze at the confirmation step too. Can you confirm whether the service is currently available for evening arrivals, or if I should use the older reservation sheet instead? I also need to know how long the confirmation takes, because a few attendees are asking before 8 a.m., and the volunteer team needs a final count. If the problem is just the browser cache, tell me what to tell them, and I will put a short note in the schedule. I do not want anyone standing outside with a paper slip if the digital voucher will not scan when they arrive. Please reply when you have ten minutes, and include the phone number for the service desk if you have it. It happened twice today, so I would want a clear workaround rather than another apology from the web team.
